verdict.rationale: Linear's developer docs describe outbound webhooks that send HTTP push notifications whenever data is created, updated or removed. Consumers can register them programmatically through the webhookCreate GraphQL mutation, and a community user reports relying on Linear's API and webhooks in their CI automation. Missing for 10: detail on event-type filtering, payload signing/verification and retry semantics is not in the evidence pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Linear provides webhooks which allow you to receive HTTP push notifications whenever data is created, updated or removed.
call the webhookCreate mutation with the teamId (or allPublicTeams: true) and url of your webhook
its GraphQL API and webhooks keep them happy
